stories.title: Recommendations with a longer horizon
stories.summary: Exploring how Transformer models and reinforcement learning can connect financial goals, risk, and portfolio decisions.
stories.contribution: Architected Transformer-based models for financial data and a reinforcement-learning recommendation policy, supported by a React interface and Python API.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body: Asset recommendations need to account for more than similarity or historical returns. This project explores goal fulfillment, volatility, and drawdown together, across different risk profiles.

sections.title: The approach
sections.body: Historical market data feeds Transformer models and a Gaussian policy-gradient recommendation model. Block bootstrap and Monte Carlo simulations support evaluation under a range of market scenarios.

sections.title: Evaluation and boundaries
sections.body: The evaluation considers policy convergence, risk-profile behavior, and comparisons with S&P 500 and 60/40 baselines. Published comparative results are not yet available. Simulations are experimental and do not establish future investment performance.
